inputs.name: ClaudeToolsSerializer.constructor.repository
inputs.description: The repository instance retained by the serializer and used by each generated tool to wait for its result. It must expose waitForTool(session, id), which receives the supplied session and a generated call_-prefixed UUID.

inputs.name: ClaudeToolsSerializer.server.definitions
inputs.description: The definitions passed through gatewayToolDefinitions and mapped to SDK tool definitions when server is called. Mapped entries are limited to function and custom; function entries are converted from their JSON Schema parameters, while custom entries receive a required string input field.

inputs.name: ClaudeToolsSerializer.server.session
inputs.description: The gateway session captured by the generated tool callbacks and passed to waitForTool. If session.emit exists, each tool callback emits its call event before awaiting the result; event arguments are JSON serialized.

outputs.name: ClaudeToolsSerializer.server
outputs.description: The server value returned by createSdkMcpServer, configured with name codex, version 0.1.0, and one generated tool for each mapped definition. Each generated tool is named tool_<index> and only supports function or custom definitions.

errors.name: UnsupportedToolShapeError
errors.description: Thrown while creating a tool when its definition type is neither function nor custom. The message is Unsupported Codex tool shape.
